notes.title: Mordeny is Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]🎮 **Mordeny Has Officially Launched!**[/h1][p]After one year of solo development, **Mordeny** is now live on Steam!
Jump into high-speed arena battles, unlock wild abilities, and climb the global leaderboard.

---
[b]🧩 **Core Gameplay**[/b]
- Laser-based shooting with 3 equipable abilities
- Match types: 1v1, 2v2, 1v1v1, and 1v1v1v1
- Round-based battles with upgrade phases

---

[b]🎮 **Game Modes**[/b]
- Classic, Competitive, and Experimental

---
[b]👥 **Multiplayer**[/b]
- Real-time lobbies (up to 4 players)
- Friends system, invites, in-game chat

---

[b]🧠 **Progression**[/b]
- Unlimited leveling
- Unlock powers and inventory items

---

[b]🛍️ **Customization**[/b]
- Skins, hats, rings, banners & more
- Some cosmetics affect speed, damage, or shield

---

[b]🌐 **Website**[/b]
- Visit \[[url="https://mordeny.com"]mordeny.com[/url]] for updates, merch, and more!

---

[b]🔥 **Made With Heart**[/b]
- No templates, no shortcuts
- No game engine — 100% HTML/CSS/JS
- Built solo over 365 days

---  

[b]🎉 **Play Now on Steam**[/b]
Let the battle begin. Lasers ready, set, go!


[b][i]"Hey! If you have any issues, let me know at \[contact@mordeny.com] or Steam discussions. I'm solo and improving. Thanks for trying Mordeny ❤️"[/i][/b]

#Mordeny #SteamLaunch #ArenaShooter #IndieGame [/p][p][/p][p][/p]
